def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # ---- Pre-aggregate payments to order level (handle split payments) ----
    pay = db['payments']
    # Only payment info already known at seed_time
    pay_past = pay[pay['ts'] < seed_time]
    order_payments = pay_past.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        has_credit_card=('payment_type', lambda x: 1 if 'credit_card' in x.values else 0),
        has_boleto=('payment_type', lambda x: 1 if 'boleto' in x.values else 0),
    ).reset_index()
    if order_payments.empty:
        order_payments = pd.DataFrame(columns=['order_id', 'total_payment',
                                               'avg_payment_installments',
                                               'has_credit_card', 'has_boleto'])
    else:
        order_payments['total_payment'] *= 0.0  # placeholder, replaced below
        order_payments = pay_past.groupby('order_id').agg(
            total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            avg_payment_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            has_credit_card=('payment_type', lambda x: float(1 if 'credit_card' in x.values else 0)),
            has_boleto=('payment_type', lambda x: float(1 if 'boleto' in x.values else 0)),
        ).reset_index()

    # ---- Pre-aggregate reviews to order level; only reviews existing at seed_time ----
    rev = db['reviews']
    rev_past = rev[rev['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    order_reviews = rev_past.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        num_reviews=('review_id', 'count'),
        share_positive=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).mean() if len(x) > 0 else 0.0),
    ).reset_index()
    if order_reviews.empty:
        order_reviews = pd.DataFrame(columns=['order_id', 'avg_review_score',
                                              'num_reviews', 'share_positive'])

    # ---- Filter relevant order items (target products, purchases before seed_time) ----
    items = db['order_items']
    relevant_items = items[
        items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    # Orders: keep all order info (status/purchase ts are historical facts),
    # but delivery dates are masked so they are only used if known before seed_time
    orders = db['orders'][['order_id', 'order_status',
                           'order_delivered_customer_date',
                           'order_estimated_delivery_date']].copy()
    # Delivery info only counts as known if the order was actually delivered before seed_time
    delivered_known = (orders['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()) & \
                      (orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    orders.loc[~delivered_known, 'order_delivered_customer_date'] = pd.NaT

    if not relevant_items.empty:
        items_full = relevant_items.merge(orders, on='order_id', how='left') \
                                   .merge(order_payments, on='order_id', how='left') \
                                   .merge(order_reviews, on='order_id', how='left')
        items_full['days_before_seed'] = (seed_time - items_full['ts']).dt.days
        items_full['window'] = pd.cut(
            items_full['days_before_seed'],
            bins=[-1, 90, 180, 360, float('inf')],
            labels=['w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'older']
        )
        items_full['is_successful'] = ~items_full['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable'])
        items_full['is_failed'] = items_full['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable'])
        items_full['delivery_delay_days'] = (
            items_full['order_delivered_customer_date'] - items_full['order_estimated_delivery_date']
        ).dt.days
    else:
        items_full = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            'product_id', 'order_id', 'order_item_id', 'price', 'freight_value', 'ts',
            'order_status', 'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date',
            'total_payment', 'avg_payment_installments', 'has_credit_card', 'has_boleto',
            'avg_review_score', 'num_reviews', 'share_positive',
            'days_before_seed', 'window', 'is_successful', 'is_failed', 'delivery_delay_days'
        ])

    def get_agg_features(df, mask, suffix):
        filtered = df[mask]
        if filtered.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index([], name='product_id'))
        def safe_nunique_success(x):
            sub = filtered.loc[x.index]
            return sub.loc[sub['is_successful'], 'order_id'].nunique()
        def safe_nunique_failed(x):
            sub = filtered.loc[x.index]
            return sub.loc[sub['is_failed'], 'order_id'].nunique()
        agg = filtered.groupby('product_id').agg(
            units_sold=('order_item_id', 'count'),
            num_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            total_revenue=('price', 'sum'),
            total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            num_successful_orders=('order_id', safe_nunique_success),
            num_failed_orders=('order_id', safe_nunique_failed),
            avg_delivery_delay=('delivery_delay_days', lambda x: x.dropna().mean()),
            avg_total_payment=('total_payment', 'mean'),
            avg_installments=('avg_payment_installments', 'mean'),
            pct_credit_card=('has_credit_card', 'mean'),
            pct_boleto=('has_boleto', 'mean'),
            avg_review_score=('avg_review_score', lambda x: x.dropna().mean()),
            num_reviews=('num_reviews', 'sum'),
            share_positive_reviews=('share_positive', lambda x: x.dropna().mean()),
        )
        agg.columns = [f"{col}_{suffix}" for col in agg.columns]
        return agg

    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(list(entity_ids), name='product_id'))

    agg_w1 = get_agg_features(items_full, items_full['window'] == 'w1', 'w1')
    agg_w2 = get_agg_features(items_full, items_full['window'] == 'w2', 'w2')
    agg_w3 = get_agg_features(items_full, items_full['window'] == 'w3', 'w3')
    agg_older = get_agg_features(items_full, items_full['window'] == 'older', 'older')

    if not items_full.empty:
        prod_history = items_full.groupby('product_id').agg(
            last_purchase_ts=('ts', 'max'),
            total_units_history=('order_item_id', 'count'),
            total_revenue_history=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_review_score_history=('avg_review_score', lambda x: x.dropna().mean()),
            total_reviews_history=('num_reviews', 'sum')
        ).reset_index()
        prod_history['days_since_last_purchase'] = (seed_time - prod_history['last_purchase_ts']).dt.days
        prod_history = prod_history.drop(columns=['last_purchase_ts']).set_index('product_id')
    else:
        prod_history = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=['total_units_history', 'total_revenue_history', 'avg_review_score_history',
                     'total_reviews_history', 'days_since_last_purchase'],
            index=base.index
        )
        prod_history.index.name = 'product_id'

    features = base.join(agg_w1, how='left')
    features = features.join(agg_w2, how='left')
    features = features.join(agg_w3, how='left')
    features = features.join(agg_older, how='left')
    features = features.join(prod_history, how='left')

    features['has_history'] = (~features['total_units_history'].isna()).astype(int)

    numeric_cols = features.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    features[numeric_cols] = features[numeric_cols].fillna(0)
    features.loc[features['has_history'] == 0, 'days_since_last_purchase'] = 9999

    eps = 1e-6
    features['units_growth_w1_w2'] = (features['units_sold_w1'] - features['units_sold_w2']) / (features['units_sold_w2'] + eps)
    features['revenue_growth_w1_w2'] = (features['total_revenue_w1'] - features['total_revenue_w2']) / (features['total_revenue_w2'] + eps)
    features['units_growth_w2_w3'] = (features['units_sold_w2'] - features['units_sold_w3']) / (features['units_sold_w3'] + eps)
    features['aov_w1'] = features['total_revenue_w1'] / (features['num_orders_w1'] + eps)
    features['aov_w2'] = features['total_revenue_w2'] / (features['num_orders_w2'] + eps)
    features['aov_w3'] = features['total_revenue_w3'] / (features['num_orders_w3'] + eps)
    features['freight_ratio_w1'] = features['total_freight_w1'] / (features['total_revenue_w1'] + eps)
    features['freight_ratio_w2'] = features['total_freight_w2'] / (features['total_revenue_w2'] + eps)
    features['success_rate_w1'] = features['num_successful_orders_w1'] / (features['num_orders_w1'] + eps)
    features['success_rate_w2'] = features['num_successful_orders_w2'] / (features['num_orders_w2'] + eps)

    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    return features
